title.hr: Karijera nakon studiranja na Sveučilišnom odjelu za stručne studije
title.en: Careers after studying at the University Department of Professional Studies

description.hr: Panel rasprava o izazovima s kojima se studenti i mladi stručnjaci susreću pri ulasku na tržište rada. Kroz razmjenu iskustava stručnjaka iz različitih područja sudionici dobivaju konkretne uvide, primjere dobre prakse i smjernice za profesionalni razvoj.
description.en: A panel discussion on the challenges students and early-career professionals face when entering the labour market. Speakers from different fields share concrete insights, practical examples and guidance for professional development.

hr: Izazovi i prilike na tržištu rada
Važnost stručne prakse i izvannastavnih aktivnosti
Razvoj karijere u struci i izvan nje
en: Challenges and opportunities in the labour market
Why internships and extracurricular work matter
Building a career inside and outside your field

description.hr: Sedma međunarodna znanstveno-stručna konferencija Contemporary Issues in Economy and Technology (CIET 2026) u organizaciji Sveučilišnog odjela za stručne studije održana je 11. i 12. lipnja 2026. u Splitu, uz tematske radionice za studente i nastavnike. Program, zbornik radova i informacije za sudionike nalaze se na stranicama konferencije.
description.en: The 7th international scientific and professional conference Contemporary Issues in Economy and Technology (CIET 2026), hosted by the University Department of Professional Studies, took place on 11–12 June 2026 in Split, with thematic workshops for students and staff. The programme, proceedings and participant information are on the conference website.

en: Electrical engineering, IT and mechanical engineering

description.hr:
Alumni AXIS Split i Studentski zbor Sveučilišnog odjela za stručne studije pozivaju studente, djelatnike i alumnije Odjela na akciju dobrovoljnog darivanja krvi, koju organiziraju Gradsko društvo Crvenog križa Split i Sveučilišni odjel za stručne studije.

Krv se ne može proizvesti umjetnim putem, a jedna darovana doza, razdvojena na sastojke, može pomoći i trojici bolesnika. Pozivamo sve koji su u mogućnosti da nam se pridruže i svojim činom pomognu onima kojima je pomoć najpotrebnija. Daruj krv – spasi život!
description.en:
Alumni AXIS Split and the Student Council of the University Department of Professional Studies invite students, staff and alumni of the Department to a voluntary blood donation drive, organised by the Split branch of the Croatian Red Cross and the University Department of Professional Studies.

Blood cannot be manufactured, and a single donation, separated into its components, can help up to three patients. Everyone who is able to donate is warmly invited to join us and help those who need it most. Give blood – save a life!

hr: Darivati mogu osobe od 18 do 65 godina dobrog općeg zdravlja, teže od 55 kg
Žene mogu darivati krv svaka četiri mjeseca, a muškarci svaka tri
Ponesite osobnu iskaznicu, putovnicu ili vozačku dozvolu
Dođite odmorni i prije darivanja pojedite lagani obrok
Najmanje 8 sati prije ne pijte alkohol i ne jedite masnu hranu
O tome možete li darivati odlučuje liječnik na mjestu darivanja
en: Donors must be aged 18 to 65, in good general health and weigh over 55 kg
Women can donate every four months, men every three
Bring an identity card, passport or driving licence
Come rested and have a light meal beforehand
Avoid alcohol and fatty food for at least 8 hours before
A doctor on site decides whether you can donate
